Results.ReviewText: Nothing beats direct heat. I bought this once I purchased our new home. I rented for years and was not allowed to have a charcoal grill. First tri tip and the memories came flooding back.
Results.Title: First home , same Weber as Dad

Results.ReviewText: It’s a nice charcoal grill. Exactly what I expected with inherent Weber quality. It replaced mine that was at least 15 years old and was never put away indoors during winter.
Results.Title: Nice Upgraded Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill & warranty.  Excellent service representative, very knowledgeable regarding product concerns.
Results.Title: Warranty repair parts, readily available.

Results.ReviewText: The grill looks great (I got the copper colored version) and the ash bin mechanism is better than my old Weber kettle, but the grill leaks around the lid so it is hard to lower the airflow and the grill gets too hot.  The air outlet at the top doesn't function as it should to control airflow, and as a result it's getting too much from around the lid and flaming up inside.  I'm hoping as the grill gets used that the lid will seal better.  I had my old one for 25 years and I'm hoping, eventually, this one will be just as good.
Results.Title: Good but hoping for improvement with age

Results.ReviewText: My new Weber 22" grill is excellent, as have been the past two kettles I have owned over many years. I especially like the ash catcher improvement and ash cleaning system/bottom vent improvements. Quality has remained high and assembly was not harder than I remembered. The improved plastic handles on the cover and main unit, over the old wooden ones that weathered, are nice. The grates are of good quality. About the only thing I don't like is that Weber retained the small, inside the lid hook for hanging the lid off the side of the main unit. This has always been awkward and needed improvement. It should have, in my opinion, been improved on a simple kettle grill now costing over $200. Otherwise, the product works fine and seems like it will last as long as my last kettle did- over 15 years.
Results.Title: An updated classic that performs great

Results.ReviewText: I’m having a hard time getting the coals lit. I bought the Weber chimney. Haven’t used it yet but when I did cook on the grill the food tasted so much better. Using coals that have a smoke flavor in them.
Results.Title: 22in. Weber

Results.ReviewText: Nothing I enjoy more than doing a cook on a Weber kettle…this is why I have two !
Results.Title: Love my Weber kettle

Results.ReviewText: Really great grill all around. The hinged sides on the cooking grate come in very handy for adding more coals during indirect cooking and the ash can is very convenient and very easy to use. Clean up is a snap, very satisfied.
Results.Title: Great grill overall

ClientResponses.Response:
Your feedback is very important to us. We are very sorry to hear of your disappointment with the bolts on the handle. 

Weber is constantly working on ways to improve our products and our customer experience and we are happy to pass your suggestions along. In fact, many of our  updates are a direct result of consumer feedback.

Our Care team is reaching out to follow up. Please look for an outreach email soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: Bolts for handle need to be real Bolts, not what you pervading.
Results.Title: Bolts

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill to replace my original Weber kettle that lasted 46 years. These grills are great.
Results.Title: Second Weber in 46 years

Results.ReviewText: Been looking for a good charcoal grill for awhile now. This one here is one of the best in my book. Easy to assemble and works wonderful.
Results.Title: Great grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are so sorry to hear your experience did not match your expectations. Your grill is backed by a generous warranty. We are here to help. Our Care team is reaching out to follow up. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: Materials really went down hill. If you had a old one don’t buy a new one.
Results.Title: Very poor quality

Results.ReviewText: Overall I'm pleased. The only fault I've experienced is that the tab to hold the lid on the tub was not bent out far enough allowing the lid to fall to the ground once. I fixed it but now have a damaged lid vent lever. Little things matter.
Results.Title: Kettle grill issues

Results.ReviewText: If you are a traditional over charcoal backyard chef, this is the grill for you. The grill surface is large enough to accommodate several food items. The vent controls are spot on and the ash catcher makes cleanup easy. It is a ruggedly built. The only negative is the assembly instructions are poorly written.
Results.Title: Weber Premium Kettle Grill Does Not Disappoint

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po
Results.ReviewText: Super BBQ, la température est facile à contrôler avec les deux prises d’air.
Results.Title: J’adore ce BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Just simple bbq,I’ve had gas grills and parts wear out. The simpler the better it makes you better
Results.Title: Simple is best

Results.ReviewText: Wonderful grill I’m still waiting for the rest of my order and it’s been a while????
Results.Title: Wonderful grill it’s my 3rd one

Results.ReviewText: I had one for many years but sold it during a move.  This one has a better-designed ash collection method but is otherwise the same classic design and is still a quality product.
Results.Title: A classic

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill, cooks well, but read the book so you don't leave the bottom vent closed, and easy to get rid of ashes
Results.Title: Weber Cooks good

Results.ReviewText: I have been using this particular grill/style for years, overall quality is good. Most recent purchase had a minor flaw with how the grate sits but nothing major.
Results.Title: Long time user

Results.ReviewText: So far I have cooked London Broils, burgers, T-Bone steaks and some roasts. Don’t want to heat up your house? Go out and use the grill. I hear grew up with charcoal. This is the way.
Results.Title: This is the way

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. Easy to control the heat for whatever I'm grilling. Large surface to hold any cut of meat.
Results.Title: Fantastic BBQ

Results.ReviewText: For the past three BBQ's I haven't faced any concerns. Easy to set up when you first open the box. Easy to dispose of ashes when you're in a pinch. Also less wait time to cool down after cooking.
Results.Title: No issue..Seems legit.

Results.ReviewText: Good quality but it should come with a cast iron grid. This should be the claim of a result-oriented (best BBQ experience) company like Weber. If it comes with a cast iron grid, the price would be o.k.
Results.Title: Nice charcoal Grill but pricy

Results.ReviewText: Cooking on it has been great. Love the flip up grate for adding charcoal or smoking woods. Only complaint is with the assembly. The powder coating in the leg holes made it more difficult than it have to insert the legs, had to use a hammer.
Results.Title: Assembly 3stars, Cooking 5stars

Results.ReviewText: Best charcoal grill on the market. Very happy with purchase.
Results.Title: Great product and even better price.

Results.ReviewText: I have owned 3 of these grills over the past 40 years and will never own anything else. The grill does everything you need it to do while also looking great. From steak or burgers over direct heat or roasting using indirect heat - you can't go wrong. Pair the grill with a chimney starter and you have all you need to enjoy many years of outdoor cooking on the best grill available at any price!
Results.Title: A design classic that works great too!

Results.ReviewText: Simple and straightforward. I’ve only used my new grille a couple times, but it hold the heat great, cooks evenly, and cleans easily. All I hoped for.
Results.Title: Weber Classic

Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd weber in 30 years, So I am happy with the abuse they take over the years.  Very happy with the ease of assembly and the quality of the materials.
Results.Title: Another Weber work horse.

Results.ReviewText: Best charcoal grill Iv'e ever owned! I would definately recomend this Weber grill to anyone who enjoys cooking out. I give 5☆☆☆☆☆ for quality, looks, and ease of use.
Results.Title: 5 ☆☆☆☆☆

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. I’ve owned a number of Weber grills, from the Smokey Joe all the way up. I have given away some too as gifts. I always return to Weber. Can’t beat the ease of using them and the fantastic results every time.
Results.Title: Best Grills Ever

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback. We are so sorry to hear your coals are going out and your lid vent is hot. We are here to help. The lid handle can get hot during use, or if left in the sun. We always recommend wearing a BBQ mitt when using the grill. Our Care team is reaching out to assist you further. Please look for our outreach soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: When you spread out the hot coals and open the vents , top and bottom , why does the coals go out when you close the lid ?  Also the top vent on the lid gets very hot and you must use an object to open and close it. I do like the grate with the hindged grate for adding coals..
Results.Title: Dan's view

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
